notes: This is a multi-year (2009-2011), two-cultivar (Nandrin F1, Napoli F1) carrot study testing Aminoplant (protein hydrolysate biostimulant) at two doses. GT dose units appear to be L/ha while JSON uses dm3/ha — these are equivalent (1 L = 1 dm3), but GT records 0.5 and 1 while JSON records 1.5 and 3.0, implying a 3x scaling discrepancy. Most likely the GT reflects 0.5 and 1 L/ha for a specific application event (each of 2 applications), while the JSON records total seasonal dose (0.5*3=1.5 or the paper reports dm3/ha per season). GT unit for yield is approximately 10x smaller than JSON t/ha (consistent with t/10a or similar regional unit). The 4 high-confidence matches (GT pairs 575-578) are confirmed by exact effect-size identity. GT pairs 573-574 (ctrl_mean=1.55 group) are unmatched — these likely correspond to a year 2009 marketable yield dataset that the extractor did not capture, as JSON has no yield observations for 2009.
